summary.headline: Zodiacal and Ecliptic Divisions
summary.text: Defense of the Zodiac’s natural division against transferring signs to the equinoctial circle, arguing that planetary motions and fixed-star configurations produce effects within the Zodiac. The equinoctial is assigned as the rule of the primum mobile and distributor of time, while the Ecliptic is divided into twelve equal parts by circles from its poles.
